output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increase in balance is not checked for overflow, allowing the total supply to be arbitrarily increased.
The foreignBuy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increase in balance is not checked for overflow, allowing the total supply to be arbitrarily increased.
The ForeignBuy function has a wrong logic vulnerability. It allows the owner to increase the balance of any user, causing a loss of funds.
The ForeignBuy function has a bad randomness vulnerability. It uses predictable time to increase the balance, attackers can manipulate the output.
The ForeignBuy function has an access control vulnerability. It only allows the owner to increase the balance, attackers can not increase their balance.
